signal: Two over-props in one game (teammates or opponents), lines at the player's season average, sigma = sqrt(avg)*1.15, rho from the measured sgp_rho register; max 2 tickets per date.
universe: all 26 games on the official 2026-11-19 .. 2026-11-22 slate (data/raw/official_schedule_capture_2026-11-19_39b70241.json: 2026-11-19=4, 2026-11-20=9, 2026-11-21=6, 2026-11-22=7); source file data/raw/official_schedule_capture_2026-11-19_39b70241.json; window rule = the newest official schedule capture, today (UTC) + up to 3 days per the project brief
exact_settlement_rule: Legs settle from official box-score points (Over if pts > line). Inactive player = VOID leg (removed; remaining legs settle at the frozen ticket price). Any losing leg loses stake 1.10; all-live-legs-win pays 1.10 * (1/joint_prob_rho - 1) at the price frozen at publication.
price_status: No licensed two-sided price exists (no odds feed; F-W07). Spread/total tickets settle on the repo's paper -110 convention (stake 1.10 to win 1.00). Moneyline strategies record W/L only; unit ROI stays blank until a price exists. SGP tickets settle at the model's published joint_prob_rho as fair price.
